'''Imperial Relations''' was an organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. [[Marga Captison]], mother of [[Bakuran]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Gaeriel Captison]], was a spokeswoman for Imperial Relations despite secretly being a member of the [[Bakuran resistance]].
